answer: Each identity must burn one earned relic: a work record under its operator's opal key, filed on the terrace registry with a 15-credit bond. Earning a relic costs 60 credits of work, so one costs 75 all-in; the k-th relic by the same operator in one epoch costs 60+10(k-1) plus the 15 bond, as audits queue up. One thousand fakes thus cost 5,070,000 credits, no bulk discount. Reuse fails twice: each relic's sparrow code is single-use, spent at first filing, and a rented relic's opal signature mismatches the filer's key, so the bond burns. An honest operator burns one relic, paying 75 once.
